verdict.rationale: HumanLayer documents `humanlayer automation run` for running a Cloud-visible coding session from any automation environment, explicitly including a CI job. Launch tokens support non-interactive commands, and the agent can open draft PRs, so a pipeline can kick off an agent run. Missing for 10: no documented example or recipe for triggering on a failed build or test (e.g., passing failure logs into the session), no detail on how automation sessions return fixes as commits or PRs back to the pipeline, and no independent or hands-on corroboration.
